score_definition: s = max confidence over predicted fire/smoke boxes (0.0 if none); inference conf=0.001
cost_model: per frame: base_rate*[TPR*c_tp+(1-TPR)*c_fn] + (1-base_rate)*[FPR*c_fp+(1-FPR)*c_tn] + staffing; reviewed positives caught with human_recall, reviewed negatives escalated with human_fpr; staffing = FTE*paid_hours*hourly/frames_per_day, FTE = max(workload, coverage floor) if any review
frame_level_note: raw test-set counts; precision depends on test prevalence, not the base rate
